response: DataFlow AI, a data infrastructure startup founded in 2022, has quickly gained momentum in the tech industry. After securing $8.5 million in Series A funding at a $42 million valuation, the company is led by an 18-person team and backed by prominent investors like Sequoia and Y Combinator. With a monthly recurring revenue (MRR) of $120,000 and an impressive 25% month-over-month growth, DataFlow AI is positioning itself as a rising player in the data infrastructure sector.
